output.summary: The district is applying to the California Department of Education for After School Education and Safety (ASES) grant funds. The request is $26,010,024.36 over three years ($8,670,008.12 a year) for after school programs at 57 elementary and middle schools, from July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2023. If the grant is awarded, in whole or in part, the board also accepts it.

output.headline: Approves a no-cost agreement for Reel Stories to teach filmmaking at two secondary schools
output.summary: The board approves a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Reel Stories of Oakland to provide its media literacy and filmmaking curriculum, plus equipment, so students can make their own short films at United for Success Academy and Madison Park Academy Secondary. It costs the district nothing. It runs from January 1, 2020 through December 31, 2022.

output.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide a full-time (40 hours a week) AmeriCorps team member to help Oakland High School's work-based learning staff. output.headline: Pays East Bay Asian Youth Center up to $40,000 for wellness support for new immigrant students
output.summary: East Bay Asian Youth Center will support newly arrived immigrant students at Oakland International High School who face poverty and trauma. Services include orientations, wellness checks, restorative justice circles, mentoring, wellness trips and early connections to behavioral health help. The contract runs January 1 through June 30, 2020, and began before the board's approval.

output.summary: Soccer Without Borders will run a soccer and wellness program at Oakland International High School. It includes a program director and coach, home visits, at least 16 wellness workshops, small-group sessions for 25 students, and help with conflict mediation. The contract runs August 12, 2019 through June 30, 2020, and the board is approving it after the work began.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $5,659.98 for Jung Choi Independent Production videos for Rudsdale Newcomer High
output.summary: Jung Choi Independent Production will make two promotional videos about Rudsdale Newcomer High School's Health Pathway, one on the pathway exhibition and one showing newcomer students' experiences. The district also receives the raw footage of the December graduation. The contract runs November 4, 2019 through May 29, 2020, and the board is approving it after the work began.

output.summary: On the Charters Committee's recommendation, the board appoints four people to the governing boards of charter schools it authorizes: Anthony Wilson (Bay Area Technology Charter School), David Kakishiba (North Oakland Community Charter School), Giselle Hendrie (Oakland Military Institute) and Edward Huang (Vincent Academy). The contract is $123,904, paid from the Measure B bond fund, with work scheduled from March 12 to December 31, 2020.

output.headline: Reappoints two members to the Measure G1 teacher retention and middle school oversight commission
output.summary: The board confirms the Board President's nominations of Monique Adorno-Jimenez (third term) and Amana Harris (second term) to the Measure G1 oversight commission. output.summary: The board amends its Board By-Law 9130 on board committees by adding a section on partnership committees with other public entities. The first one is an Education Partnership Committee with the Oakland City Council, and the amendment defines its purpose and membership.
